name: youtube-video-player
title: YouTube Video Player
description: A rounded 16:9 video card showing a poster, a centred play button and the title. Pressing play swaps in an autoplaying YouTube embed, and the corner expand button blows it up over a dimmed page.
use: You have a YouTube clip and want a poster card that opens it large, in-page, without leaving the layout.
avoid: You need self-hosted or offline media: playback depends on YouTube and its iframe.
a11y: The dimmed backdrop is a clickable div with only an aria-label and no button role, so keyboard users can close it just with Escape. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A rounded 16:9 card filled with the Big Buck Bunny cover, a large circular play button with a dark triangle in the middle, the title just below it, and a small round expand icon at the top right. Once playing it becomes the YouTube embed with its own header and controls.
behaves: Clicking play replaces the poster with an autoplaying YouTube iframe. The expand button grows the card into a centred overlay over a blurred dark backdrop and its icon flips to minimise; Escape closes the overlay.
customise: videoId and customThumbnail set the clip and poster, title sets the caption, and about a dozen className props restyle each part. Behaviour is fixed.
weight: light: One image and a layout animation; the YouTube iframe only loads after play.
